newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-BHP says Griffin oil output still idle.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-BHP says Griffin oil output still idle.

text.p: The Griffin floating oil platform was awaiting calmer seas before reconnecting to its production mooring in the Indian Ocean off Western Australia, The Broken Hill Pty Co Ltd said on Friday.
"We are waiting for the appropriate sea conditions before reconnecting," a BHP spokesman told Reuters.
BHP shut in Griffin late on Monday as the now dissipated cyclone Rachel bore down on Western Australia's offshore fields.
BHP holds a 45 percent interest in the Griffin oil project and is the operator. Mobil Corp holds 35 percent and Inpex Alpha Ltd owns the remaining 20 percent.
Production had been averaging about 60,000 barrels a day in recent weeks, the spokesman said.
"We're back in location and now just waiting," he said.
